# Younick Design Studio

> Luxury interior design, architecture, and turnkey construction studio in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

Younick Design Studio is a premier luxury interior design, architecture, and turnkey construction firm based in Civil Lines, Jaipur. We specialize in transforming residential villas, apartments, commercial offices, healthcare facilities, gyms, and retail boutiques into bespoke, timeless environments.

## Key Facts

- Founded and led by Nikhil Sain (Lead Interior Designer & Architect)
- Studio location: 3008, Third Floor, Orbit Mall, Civil Lines, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302001
- Phone: +91 88548 83058
- Email: studioyounick@gmail.com
- Operating hours: Monday–Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- 14+ signature projects delivered across Jaipur and Rajasthan
- 5 core turnkey services offered
- 4.9★ average client rating from 128+ reviews
- Residential interior pricing starts from ₹1,200/sq.ft
- Areas served: Jaipur (Civil Lines, C-Scheme, Vaishali Nagar, Mansarovar, Malviya Nagar, Jagatpura, Pratap Nagar, Tonk Road), Sikar, Udaipur, Jodhpur, Kota, and all of Rajasthan

## Services

1. **Luxury Residential & Villa Interior Design**: Bespoke spatial layouts, custom modular kitchens (Blum/Hettich hardware), Italian marble finishes, false ceilings, and curated master suites. Timeline: 4–8 weeks. Starting from ₹1,200/sq.ft.
2. **Turnkey Civil Construction & Execution**: Foundation-to-finish structural engineering using IS-grade steel, BWP plywood, and premium stone. Full project management and on-site supervision. Timeline: 4–8 months.
3. **Architectural Renovation & Remodeling**: Structural wall modifications, plumbing retrofitting, contemporary interior revamps, and energy-efficient upgrades for homes, havelis, and commercial spaces. Timeline: 3–6 weeks.
4. **Architectural & Interior Consultation**: Feasibility analysis, 2D floor plans, Vastu-aligned spatial guidance, accurate BOQ cost estimation, and material advisory. Timeline: 3–7 days.
5. **3D Architectural Visualization & Walkthroughs**: Photorealistic interior/exterior renders, lighting simulation, VR walkthroughs, and CAD construction drawings. Timeline: 5–10 working days.

## Signature Projects

- Hera Mahal, Jaipur — Luxury heritage residential interior
- Six Eleven Fitness Club, Jaipur — Commercial gym interior with acoustic treatment
- Chhoti Bai Jewellers, Jaipur — High-end jewellery boutique with brass display vitrines
- Devi Lal Memorial Eye Hospital (DLMEH) — Clinical space planning and healthcare interiors
- Detailing Devils Studio, Jaipur — Automotive studio with high-CRI tunnel lighting
- Dharmendra Luxury Villa, Jaipur — Modern 4BHK with double-height living foyer
- PCP Sikar Educational Campus — Academic reception and administrative suites

Essential (₹1,200–₹1,800/sq.ft), Premium (₹1,800–₹2,800/sq.ft), Luxury (₹2,800–₹4,500+/sq.ft). URL: https://yds-liart.vercel.app/blog/interior-design-cost-jaipur-2026
2. **Best Modular Kitchen Materials for Rajasthan's Climate**: Thermal delamination and dust resistance guide. Comparing IS:710 BWP Marine Plywood, HDHMR, Acrylic shutters, and Quartz countertops against 45°C+ summer heat. URL: https://yds-liart.vercel.app/blog/best-modular-kitchen-materials-rajasthan-hot-climate
3. **Vastu Guidelines for Luxury Villa Entrances & Spatial Planning**: Harmonizing traditional Vedic orientations (Ishanya, Agni, Nairutya) with contemporary open-plan luxury villa architecture in Jaipur. URL: https://yds-liart.vercel.app/blog/vastu-guidelines-luxury-villa-design-jaipur
4. **Turnkey Construction vs Local Labor Contractors in Jaipur**: Detailed financial risk analysis explaining why fragmented contractor hiring causes 30% cost overruns versus single-point turnkey accountability. URL: https://yds-liart.vercel.app/blog/turnkey-construction-vs-local-contractors-jaipur
5. **Why 3D Architectural Renders Save 20% on Villa Construction**: Preventing on-site demolition, HVAC/false ceiling clashes, and color mistakes through physically-based 3D CGI simulations. URL: https://yds-liart.vercel.app/blog/why-3d-architectural-renders-save-construction-cost
